name: Halloweenapalooza
blurb: Ottumwa, Iowa's horror film festival and convention with a zombie walk, costume contest, celebrity guests and live entertainment.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Friday, October 9th & Saturday, October 10th of 2026 FRI 5-11pm, SAT noon-midnight'; venue via hotel page: 'the brand new hotel right outside Bridge View Center.'

notes: Guest cards on the GUESTS 2026 page carry only a promotional photo and name, no written bio, so credits for Ken Foree, Miguel Núñez and Jeremy Palko come from general knowledge of well-known horror-film actors and a web search confirming this year's roster; that same search also surfaced Justin Beahm (Shock Waves podcast / horror-doc producer), Sam Rezz (sideshow/circus performer) and that 'Cracktastic Plastic' is a live action-figure-collecting podcast recording (hosted by Jason Bolinger and Mike Saunders of Prescribed Films, who the search describes as the event's organizers) rather than a single person -- picked as one guest per the groups/acts rule. Mark Donovan and Gino Crognale could not be identified with confidence from the site or the search, so their cat is 'other' and known-for is left blank rather than guessed, per instructions.
